_doc: Canonical registry of every active credential powering the agent OS. See shared/credentials-discipline.md for the rule that governs adds/edits. Validated by scripts/validate_token_rotation_schedule.py. Read by Pulse (every cycle, rotation-window check) and by scripts/heal_credential_registry_drift.py (every 6h, drift detection).

credentials.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
credentials.purpose: Vercel deploy API access for scripts/deploy_notifier.py (E2.2) and future deploy operations
credentials.notes: Hobby tier; Vercel deprecated no-expiration tokens in 2024 so 365d is the practical max.

credentials.name: GITHUB_GH_OAUTH_TOKEN
credentials.purpose: Forge commits + push + gh pr create; Mirror gh pr review; healer gh pr merge
credentials.notes: gh-OAuth tokens (gho_*) are non-expiring; audit scopes annually. 'gist' is the likely audit win — no gh-gist usage observed in agent OS code.

credentials.name: CLAUDE_MAX_OAUTH
credentials.purpose: Claude Code authentication for Beacon, Forge, Mirror, Pulse on droplet (Max subscription tied to agent.beacon.ourliberty@gmail.com)
credentials.notes: Access token auto-refreshes via refreshToken; subscription billing is the load-bearing rotation signal. Annual entry is for billing + tier audit (have we accumulated unused capacity? do we need to increase?).

credentials.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN
credentials.purpose: workspace-mcp access to Google Docs + Drive for Beacon (E5 spec-drafting workflow)
credentials.notes: Auto-refreshes via refresh-token. OAuth client is in Testing mode in beacon-agent Google Cloud project. Revocable via Cloud Console if compromised. Annual audit: are Docs+Drive still the right scope set, or has Beacon's workflow expanded to need Gmail/Calendar at this layer too?

credentials.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN_BEACON
credentials.purpose: Beacon's Telegram bot identity (@OLH_Beacon_bot); Larry's primary chat-with-Beacon channel
credentials.notes: Telegram bot tokens don't expire. Rotate via BotFather only on suspected compromise. Runbook covers the swap procedure.

credentials.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN_FORGE
credentials.purpose: Forge's Telegram bot identity (@OLH_Forge_bot); ack/result channel for build dispatches
credentials.notes: Shares runbook with other Telegram bots.

credentials.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN_MIRROR
credentials.purpose: Mirror's Telegram bot identity (@OLH_Mirror_bot); review-result channel
credentials.notes: Shares runbook with other Telegram bots.

credentials.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN_PULSE
credentials.purpose: Pulse's Telegram bot identity (@OLH_Pulse_bot); cycle-digest + alert channel
credentials.notes: Shares runbook with other Telegram bots.

credentials.name: TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID_LARRY
credentials.purpose: Larry's numeric Telegram chat ID; target for all DM routing (larry_alerts.append_alert/notification reply_chat_id)
credentials.notes: This is an identifier, not a secret — numeric chat ID resolved via @userinfobot. Included in registry so drift healer accepts it as expected presence; not a rotation candidate. Discovered missing during first credential-drift healer run on 2026-05-19.

credentials.name: DASHBOARD_API_TOKEN
credentials.purpose: Read-only dashboard API auth (E3.1); shared between droplet API (scripts/dashboard_api.py) and Vercel-hosted Next.js UI in E3.2
credentials.notes: Shared secret, not OAuth. Rotation requires updating BOTH .env.larry on the droplet AND the Vercel project env vars (Production + Preview + Development); both must change in the same window or the dashboard breaks. calendar_event_url is intentionally null at PR time per the E3.1 spec § 4.6 item 4 — Larry will DM Beacon post-merge to create the annual scope-audit calendar event and a follow-up small commit will paste the URL here.

credentials.name: TELEGRAM_ALLOWED_CHAT_IDS
credentials.purpose: Comma-separated list of authorized Telegram chat IDs (currently just Larry); used by Telegram bot ACLs to gate inbound chat
credentials.notes: Identifier, not a secret. Add new chat IDs here as the system gains authorized operators. Discovered missing during first credential-drift healer run on 2026-05-19.

env_file:/home/larry/credentials/.env.la.description: Primary environment file for systemd unit EnvironmentFile= references
env_file:/home/larry/credentials/.env.la.scanner_strategy: parse KEY=value lines; ignore comments and blank lines; non-empty value = present

gh_cli:/home/larry/.config/gh/hosts.yml.description: gh CLI keychain set by `gh auth login`
gh_cli:/home/larry/.config/gh/hosts.yml.scanner_strategy: run `gh auth status` and parse the 'Token scopes' line

claude_cli:/home/larry/.claude/.credenti.scanner_strategy: JSON parse; claudeAiOauth key present and accessToken non-empty = active

workspace_mcp:/home/larry/.google_worksp.description: workspace-mcp OAuth refresh tokens, one JSON file per Google account
workspace_mcp:/home/larry/.google_worksp.scanner_strategy: ls credentials/ for non-empty .json files (one per registered account)
